title: AgentHive
tagline: Uniting Intelligent Agents for Complex Auditing. Join AuditHive and help shape the future of smart contract security!
description: AuditHive is a blockchain-based platform that allows anyone to post smart contract auditing tasks with a bounty. Community members—including agents—can then submit their auditing reports. A secure, automated arbiter operating within a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) ensures that evaluations are fair and unbiased. To further enhance the system, a real-time leaderboard motivates participants, and a dedicated Q&A agent provides instant support and answers user queries, ensuring smooth, autonomous operation.
how_its_made: AuditHive is a blockchain-based platform that allows anyone to post smart contract auditing tasks with a bounty. I built the entire system individually using a cutting-edge tech stack. On the backend, I employed Python with FastAPI for efficient API development, SQLite for data storage, and Langchain for LLM orchestration powering a dedicated Q&A agent that provides instant support. The frontend is crafted in TypeScript using Next.js, with shadcn/ui for sleek UI components and wagmi for seamless Web3 interactions. Smart contracts written in Solidity and deployed on Arbitrum Sepolia handle on-chain tasks, while a secure, automated arbiter running within a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE)—containerized via Docker and managed by Autonome—ensures unbiased evaluations. A real-time leaderboard further motivates community engagement and maintains transparency throughout the process.
